lines.text: Hiya, come and sit down. Did you find us alright?
Eventually, the satnav sent me round the industrial estate twice.
It does that to everyone. So what's going on?
I'm coming in with a groin ache on the left side, it's been building for about three months.
It just crept up, it's worse after I've been gardening.
Any previous surgery on that hip or your back?
No previous surgeries on the hip or back, ever.
Let me have a look. Lie back for me.
Bringing the knee across and turning it in gives you that groin pain, and you've lost about a third of the inward turn compared with the right.
That fits with early wear and tear in the hip joint, but I'd want an X ray to be sure, so I'll ask your doctor for one.
Fair enough. Can I keep playing bowls?
Bowls is fine, just keep the lunges shallow on the delivery, and stop if it catches sharply.
Okay, that's us for today. Lovely to meet you, see you in a fortnight.
Alright, come through, pet. Are you the half past?
That's me. Sorry, the buses are a nightmare round here.
Tell me about it. Sit yourself down.
So it's my lower back, it's been seizing up every time I stand up from the desk.
